details.description: This Hangman game includes a broad collection of words across different categories, creating a more engaging and varied gameplay experience. Players can select between Easy and Hard difficulty levels, each designed with its own balance of time and hints. Easy mode provides a longer time limit and additional hints for a relaxed experience, while Hard mode challenges players with less time and fewer hints, requiring quicker thinking and stronger vocabulary skills.
highlights: Implemented bilingual support (English/Arabic)
Built a dynamic on-screen keyboard with state management
Developed countdown timer logic for timed gameplay
Created score tracking across multiple rounds
Managed game state transitions for win/loss scenarios

details.description: Evenvite is an event management platform designed to simplify the process of creating and organizing events. Users can host public events that anyone can reserve or create private events with a selected guest list. Invited guests receive a digital invitation card where they can view event details and send respond directly to the organizer, making communication and attendance management seamless and efficient.
highlights: Built RESTful APIs for event and invitation management
Designed MongoDB data models
Implemented private and public event access control
Developed guest attendance confirmation workflow
Created dynamic digital invitation card functionality

details.description: An e-learning platform designed for both instructors and students. Instructors can create and manage courses with structured lessons, while students can enroll in courses, access learning materials, and monitor their progress. The platform includes dedicated dashboards, lesson pages for educational content, and real-time progress tracking to provide an organized and engaging learning experience.
highlights: Integrated frontend and backend services
Developed instructor dashboard features
Restricted lesson access to enrolled students
Integrated Markdown for lesson content display
Implemented student progress tracking functionality

details.description: A modern space reservation platform designed to simplify the process of finding and booking suitable environments for work, study, or collaboration. Users can browse available meeting rooms, workspaces, and study halls, then reserve them through a seamless and user-friendly experience. The platform focuses on accessibility, flexibility, and convenience, helping individuals find the right space to meet their needs with confidence.
highlights: Implemented room and venue booking functionality
Developed availability and reservation management system
Generated PDF invoices for bookings
Built user authentication and profile management

details.description: A simple and intuitive calculator designed for everyday calculations. The application supports essential arithmetic operations, including addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division, while maintaining a session-based history of recent calculations. Users can easily review their previous operations, and the history is automatically cleared when the session ends, ensuring a lightweight and straightforward experience.
highlights: Implemented basic arithmetic operations
Integrated Math.js for expression evaluation
Built session-based calculation history tracking
